title: Quickler: report writing, finally fixed
summary: A 2 minute 19 second tour of Quickler: set up a Check, do a site safety inspection on WhatsApp, and see the finished Record.
description: Inspection apps keep you at your desk for hours. Quickler is built for the in-person visit: you walk around, send photos and voice notes, and Quickler handles the processing. This short tour shows setting up a Check, a site safety inspection on WhatsApp, and the finished Record. 14 days free, no card needed.
chapters: A site safety inspection on WhatsApp
The Record and the to-do list
Branding, your team and a free trial
transcript: Report writing is finally fixed. Inspection apps keep you at your desk for hours, until Quickler came along. I'm going to show you how we fixed it. It's very simple and it will only take a few minutes.
Quickler is all about the in-person visit. You walk around, you send photos and send voice notes. And Quickler handles the processing of all the information.

Setting up is quick. Add a check here, say what you'd like checked and press continue. Or upload a file you already use, and we'll extract the questions. You can also schedule it and Quickler will chase anyone who forgets.
Here is a site safety inspection on WhatsApp. We'll say what we're checking and get talking.

You can send voice notes and photos in any order. Just like you would to a colleague. After each message, Quickler shows what's still to cover so you never lose your place. Anything you don't mention counts as okay. So you never have to tick 40 boxes later. And when you're finished, you just say done. Quickler then sorts all your photos and words into the right places, ready for you to approve.

This brings us to the record. If you don't say something, we don't make it up. If you do, we don't lose it. Every fault goes into the to-do list at the top. So issues are flagged to the reader without them having to hunt through the report. From there, they can be copied and pasted to wherever they're needed.

Don't like the way something is written? Click on any answer and type over it. Has a photo been misrouted? Drag it to wherever you like. Notice something at the end of the visit? Just say it on WhatsApp.

Sharing the report is very easy using the shareable link. Do you need it in Word, Excel, or a PDF? You can do that too. What about branding? You can get that as well. Can you add your whole team? Yes, just like this. And it does all of this as well.
Now there's plenty more, but honestly, it's way better to try for yourself. 14 days free at quickler.co. No card needed.

title: Quickler: every Fault on a To do list
summary: A 20 second look at the To do list: every Fault you mention goes to the top of the Record, ready to reword, hide, reorder and copy.
description: Every Fault you mention on WhatsApp goes straight into the To do list at the top of the Record, so nobody has to hunt for it. You can reword a line, hide one or change the order, and the person receiving the report can copy and paste it wherever it is needed.
